features.title: Turn a part in the 3D view and see its side in the plan
features.acceptance: Select a coffee-table leg in the plan and switch to the 3D view by keyboard; turning it about X is refused because relationships hold it in its own frame, a duplicate of it turned about X has its north face up and a 2 1/2" by 16 1/4" footprint in the plan, and one undo makes that footprint square again.

features.title: Set a part under the top in the 3D view
features.acceptance: In the 3D view, drag a coffee-table apron's Z arrow down and then up until the snap catches the top's underside; the drop stores a Flush of the top's bottom face and the apron's top face, the relationship list says so, and typing a 5" depth in the properties panel grows the apron downward while the top stays where it was.

features.title: The Part panel follows an edit made in the 3D view
features.acceptance: Resize a coffee-table apron's depth by its top face handle in the 3D view; the Part panel shows the new depth without reselecting, renaming it and pressing Apply keeps that depth and states no typed depth, and two undos bring back both the original name and depth in the panel.

features.title: The relationship list and the Part panel share one column
features.acceptance: At 900x600 with a coffee-table leg selected in the plan, and again with an apron picked in the 3D view, the open relationship list and the Part panel do not overlap each other or the status bar, the list scrolls because its 33 rows do not fit, and the selected part's rows come first.

features.title: A refused turn offers to let go of the relationships and turn
features.acceptance: Pressing X on a coffee-table leg in the 3D view is refused, outlines exactly the parts the relationships holding it by place name, and offers 'Let go of N and turn'; taking the offer turns the leg in place and removes exactly those relationships, and one undo restores the drawing.

features.title: Remove a relationship from its row in the list
features.acceptance: With a coffee-table leg selected, resting the pointer on the first row of the relationship list outlines the parts that relationship holds, clicking the row's remove button removes only that relationship without moving any part, and undo brings it back.

features.title: Zoom to fit frames the drawing beside the side panels
features.acceptance: With a coffee-table leg selected and the Part panel showing, zoom to fit in the plan and Home in the 3D view each put every corner of every part left of the Part panel.

features.title: The words and the plan's mark follow a part when it is turned
features.acceptance: With a standing coffee-table leg selected the Part panel's rows read East–west, North–south and Length (up) and the relationship list uses compass words with no left, right or bottom edge; a duplicate tipped about X reads East–west, Up and Length (north–south) and carries the plan mark '↑ thickness', and undo removes the mark.
